title: Shiroki Majo: Mou Hitotsu no Eiyuu Densetsu
native_title: 白き魔女 ～もうひとつの英雄伝説～
overview:
A "role-playing game that sings" - the birth of a new "Legend of Heroes"

Jurio and Chris shine even brighter in a great adventure!! Nihon Falcom's popular series, which set records as the biggest hit in PC history - the famous "Eiyuu Densetsu III" is reborn on the Sega Saturn!!

Long ago, the White Witch traveled the land on a pilgrimage, leaving prophecies wherever she went. Now no one knows what became of her. Following an old custom, Jurio and his childhood friend Chris leave their small village of Ragpick in the kingdom of Fortia to make a pilgrimage of their own, seeking out the magic mirrors called Shaline - a journey that grows into something far greater than they imagined.

- Story-focused design: command battles take place right on the field screen, so the tale flows without interruption
- Sub-events everywhere, adding scenes and battles not told in the PC version
- Quarter-view maps of richly detailed towns and villages
- All characters newly drawn by Kazuhiro Soeta, with over 20 minutes of animated movies
- A voice cast of 15
- 2 discs

「詩うロールプレイングゲーム」～新しい「英雄伝説」の誕生

ジュリオがクリスがさらに輝きを増して大活躍！！パソコン史上最強のビッグヒットを記録した日本ファルコムの人気シリーズあの「英雄伝説Ⅲ」がセガサターンで新しく生まれ変わる！！
